create_InstructBlipVisionConfig: create an InstructBlipVisionConfig with default vision transformer settings for image encoding
create_InstructBlipQFormerConfig: create an InstructBlipQFormerConfig with default cross-attention transformer settings
create_InstructBlipConfig: create an InstructBlipConfig that combines vision, qformer, and text model configurations
build_InstructBlipConfig_with_subconfigs: build an InstructBlipConfig from separate InstructBlipVisionConfig, InstructBlipQFormerConfig, and text config objects
initialize_InstructBlipConfig_with_dicts: initialize an InstructBlipConfig by passing sub-config dictionaries that get auto-converted to config objects
